research_question: On one common GGUF/CUDA backend, does the frozen SG-MMP precision allocation provide a useful accuracy-memory-speed trade-off?
inference_scope: Deployment transferability of the frozen allocation policy; not deployment validation of the original GPTQ implementation.

llama_cpp.cuda_graphs: default enabled; GGML_CUDA_DISABLE_GRAPHS must be unset

pretest_amendment.trigger: The initial CUDA 11.6 build produced an intermittent boundary-tolerance failure in the pinned backend ADD test before any deployment artifact or task-quality row was generated.
pretest_amendment.resolution: Freeze CUDA Toolkit 12.4 with GCC/G++ 12 and require five consecutive ADD executions plus one complete backend execution on each physical RTX 3090, followed by the quantization-function test; every execution must pass on its first protocol attempt.
pretest_amendment.data_available_when_frozen: toolchain and official backend-test diagnostics only; no converted deployment artifacts, performance measurements, or GSM8K deployment results existed
pretest_amendment.scientific_scope: environment qualification only; method definitions, workload, endpoints, comparisons, stopping rules, and statistical analysis are unchanged

source_weights: Each artifact is independently quantized from the immutable high-precision checkpoint recorded by revision-full-v4; requantization is forbidden.

sg.label: SG allocation-GGUF
sg.quantizer: llama-quantize --pure with exact frozen-module Q8_0 overrides

importance_matrix.source: Round-trip-exact decoded union, in seed order 41/97/193, of the existing frozen WikiText-train packed calibration streams; independent sequences are separated by one model EOS token parsed as special
importance_matrix.sequence_boundary: one model EOS token; 383 boundaries for 384 frozen sequences

tensor_policy.output_head: F16 when stored; an absent tied output is recorded, not duplicated
tensor_policy.normalization_and_other_noneligible_tens: unchanged conversion/default treatment, audited per artifact
tensor_policy.mapping_requirement: Every eligible HF module maps exactly once to GGUF and has the prescribed type; missing, duplicate, shape/parameter, or type mismatches hard fail.
tensor_policy.budget_policy: Do not retune the frozen SG selection to match Q5 bytes. Report original logical bpw, packed eligible bpw, whole-artifact bpw, and exact bytes separately.

quality.dataset: complete official GSM8K test set in dataset order

performance.backend: one pinned llama.cpp CUDA build for every method

fixed_controls.quality_gpu: the other RTX 3090; no simultaneous timing workload

performance.formal_precision_target: For SG/Q4 and SG/Q5 native-service aggregate-throughput ratios at concurrency 1 and 4, require 95% paired process-block bootstrap ratio CI half-width <= 2%; add paired blocks 10->20->30, then stop and report even if unmet.

conversion.data: eight fixed GSM8K-train prompts at indices 5..12; test is never loaded
conversion.tokenizer: 8/8 prompt token-ID arrays exactly match Hugging Face with add_special_tokens=false
conversion.chat_template: for chat models, 8/8 rendered prompt strings and token arrays are recorded and must pass the tokenizer rule
conversion.continuation: HF-FP16 versus GGUF-FP16: 8/8 first generated tokens and at least 126/128 aligned greedy continuation tokens match
conversion.logit_derived_check: On every train prompt, HF-FP16 and GGUF-FP16 first-token top-8 raw-softmax log-probabilities overlap on at least 7 token IDs and differ by at most 0.05 absolute log-probability on every common ID.

packed_backend.official_tests: With CUDA Toolkit 12.4, G++ 12, and default CUDA Graphs: five consecutive ADD test executions and one complete backend test execution pass on each physical GPU 0 and 1, then test-quantize-fns passes; no selective retry is allowed and each execution has a 900-second hard timeout.
packed_backend.data: the same eight fixed GSM8K-train prompts; test is never loaded
packed_backend.continuation: CPU versus CUDA for every packed artifact: 8/8 first generated tokens and at least 126/128 aligned greedy continuation tokens match

gates.artifact: Every tensor mapping/type/size audit passes and provenance hashes are complete.
gates.stage_progression: Engineering qwen05 is technical only. Value qwen15+smollm is precommitted. Within every test-bearing stage, every model must finish artifact construction, gates, and performance blocks before any GSM8K test row is loaded. Formal expansion requires passed gates, <=24 estimated GPU-hours, and <=40 GiB estimated additional storage.

statistics.within_process_repetitions: summarized within block; never treated as independent replicates
statistics.comparison: paired by process block; report the geometric mean of within-block method ratios with deterministic paired bootstrap confidence intervals
statistics.accuracy: paired item-level effects and intervals within each newly measured backend artifact

claim_policy.allowed: Allocation-policy transfer on this pinned GGUF/CUDA stack, with measured accuracy, storage, memory, and speed.
forbidden: Calling the new artifacts original GPTQ-W4/W5 or original SG-MMP weights
Claiming Q5 is slow merely because INT5 is not a native Tensor Core type
Using llama-bench as end-to-end TTFT or service throughput
Mixing original logical bit budget with packed file bits-per-weight
Enabling the revision-full deployment claim from this extension
